query: How do I make baked wonton chips?

goal.title: Bake seasoned wonton wrapper squares
goal.description: Open and separate square wonton wrappers, cut them into smaller squares and arrange them on a tray. Spray with oil, heat in the toaster oven with repeated inspections, remove with a towel, sprinkle salt and transfer the pieces to a small plate.
goal.final_state: Pale square wrapper pieces are piled on a small plate after heating and salting; the tray is moved away. Texture and doneness cannot be verified from the silent image alone.

procedure.description: Bring the wonton wrapper package to the cutting board and try pulling its sealed edge apart. Retrieve the chef knife, slit the plastic seam and put the knife down. Pull the opening wider, remove a square stack and move the package aside.
Separate the stuck wrapper sheets by lifting and peeling their edges apart. Lay the individual square wrappers flat in a two-by-two arrangement on the board.

Retrieve the knife and steady each wrapper with the left hand. Saw across the wrappers in one direction, reposition the blade and cut across them again in the perpendicular direction to make smaller square pieces.

Put the knife down. Repeatedly pick up and separate the small wrapper pieces and spread them in a single layer on the metal baking tray. Lift the tray and pump the oil dispenser nozzle across the pieces, then return the dispenser and carry the tray toward the toaster oven.
Open the toaster oven, slide the tray onto its rack and close the door. Turn the control dial and press the start control; the interior light illuminates.

Wait facing the lit oven. Briefly open and close the door at about 158s, adjust the control dial at about 165–172s as the light cycles, then resume waiting. Open and close the door for another inspection at about 199–202s and again at about 216–221s without visibly handling the food.

Open the door again. Use a folded towel to grip and remove the hot tray, carry it back to the cutting board and keep supporting it. Remove the lid from the salt crock and repeatedly sprinkle pinches of salt across the wrapper squares.

Retrieve the small plate and put it beside the tray. After the preserved fine track ends at 245s, use a teal-handled fork to loosen and push the wrapper pieces while tilting the tray over the plate at about 245.5–251.5s. Scrape remaining pieces free and transfer the final piece by hand at about 255s. Move the tray away; the final view shows the pale seasoned squares on the plate. Crispness is not established by the silent video.

notes: All overview sheets, every dense interval page including the entire long heating interval, both native-end sheets and 3 fps uncovered tail reviewed. Only fine boundaries trusted and preserved. Coverage gap: fine stops at 245.0s, ffprobe 262.067s; t=245.5–251.5s fork-assisted tray-to-plate transfer, t=252–255s remaining pieces removed, t=256s tray moved away, then final presentation. coarse.instruction: Open and separate the wonton wrappers
coarse.description: Bring the package onto the board, try its seal, cut it open with the knife, remove a square stack and move the package aside. Separate and flatten the individual wrapper sheets.
coarse.goal_contribution: Provides individual sheets that can be cut into snack-sized pieces.

coarse.instruction: Cut the wrappers into small squares
coarse.description: Retrieve and reposition the knife, steady the sheets with the left hand and saw across them in perpendicular directions to divide them into smaller squares.
coarse.goal_contribution: Creates the smaller pieces that will become the baked wrapper snack.
coarse.predictability_reason: Separated wrappers must be cut into squares for the stated snack.

coarse.instruction: Arrange and oil the wrapper squares
coarse.description: Put down the knife, separate and transfer the cut pieces to a single layer on the tray, lift the tray, pump oil over the pieces and carry it toward the oven.
coarse.goal_contribution: Prepares an oiled, spaced batch for heating.
coarse.predictability_reason: Cut squares are ready to spread on a tray and oil.

coarse.instruction: Bake and inspect the wrapper squares
coarse.description: Load the tray into the toaster oven, shut the door, adjust the controls and start it. Wait while the oven is lit, occasionally open and close the door to inspect the pieces, and adjust the controls once more.
coarse.goal_contribution: Heats the wrapper pieces while checking their visible progress.
coarse.predictability_reason: The prepared squares are ready to bake.

coarse.instruction: Remove and season the wrappers beside a plate
coarse.description: Open the oven and withdraw the tray with a towel, carry it to the board, uncover the salt crock and sprinkle salt across the pieces. Retrieve and place a small plate beside the tray. Actual food transfer starts after the covered fine track ends.
coarse.goal_contribution: Makes the heated, seasoned pieces ready for the subsequent visible plating operation.
coarse.predictability_reason: Baked wrappers can be removed and seasoned.
